final: WITH region_stats AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), cross_region AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS avg_amount FROM region_stats) SELECT AVG(r.avg_amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, AVG(r.transaction_count) AS avg_transaction_count, AVG(r.avg_amount - c.avg_amount) AS avg_amount_above_cross_region FROM region_stats AS r CROSS JOIN cross_region AS c WHERE r.avg_amount > c.avg_amount
